name: competitions
notes: Competitions for a season+game type, with NombreCategoria used for category filtering.

name: groups
notes: Groups within a competition, incl. total_jornadas/total_equipos/clasificacion_goleadores flags.

name: results (not used)
notes: Returns a SINGLE round's matches - would require iterating jornada 1..N per group. The calendario page below is used instead since it returns the whole season in one request.

name: calendario_page
notes: Server-rendered page; __NEXT_DATA__.props.pageProps.calendar.rounds contains ALL jornadas for the group regardless of the jornada query value. Primary source for matches/fixtures.

name: acta_partido_page
notes: Match report enrichment (goal scorers/minutes, venue, referee-adjacent fields). robots.txt: Disallow /acta-partido/ - fetched only if enrichment.fetch_acta_partido=true.

name: fichaequipo_page
notes: Team metadata enrichment (club contact info, kit colours). robots.txt: Disallow /fichaequipo/ - fetched only if enrichment.fetch_fichaequipo=true.
